data.title: Taiwan says AI agents used in cyberattacks targeting island
data.description: TAIPEI - Overseas hackers used artificial intelligence agents to help carry out a wave of cyberattacks targeting Taiwanese government agencies in July, the island's digital affairs ministry said Thursday.

data.title: Putin visits Kuril islands claimed by Japan
data.description: MOSCOW - Russian President Vladimir Putin visited the far-eastern Kuril islands for the first time on Thursday, prompting a “strong” protest by Japan which also claims the territory.

data.title: Hong Kong student arrested over B12.5m scam deceived by same swindlers
data.description: Hong Kong police have arrested a 19-year-old university student accused of swindling more than HK$3 million (12.5 million baht) from a man after apparently being hoodwinked by scammers herself.

data.title: US lawmakers demand inquiry into conditions on aircraft carrier
data.description: WASHINGTON - Congressional Democrats demanded answers on Wednesday about conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln, following reports of food shortages, broken plumbing and mental health crises during the aircraft carrier’s record-setting deployment.

data.title: ‘Imposing ignorance’: US climate science under siege
data.description: WASHINGTON - A benchmark US report on the fast-changing state of the Arctic has been cancelled. The nation’s top research body has removed a chapter on global warming from a reference manual for judges.

data.title: Astronomers discover new ‘black hole star’
data.description: PARIS - Astronomers announced on Wednesday that they had discovered a new type of astronomical object called a "black hole star", potentially solving a mystery involving strange red dots spotted in the early universe.

data.title: D-Day for Farage and Count Binface in UK poll
data.description: LONDON - Voters in eastern England head to the polls on Thursday for a by-election triggered by hard-right Reform UK leader Nigel Farage, but amid a boycott by mainstream parties his main rival is a joke candidate called Count Binface.

data.title: Tourists rush to Mount Etna as Italian volcano erupts
data.description: ROME - Spectacular images of lava flowing down the slopes of an erupting Mount Etna have drawn flocks of tourists to the Italian volcano -- to the worry of local guides.

data.title: New space object 'black hole star' discovered by astronomers
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Astronomers announced Wednesday they had discovered a new type of astronomical object called a "black hole star", potentially solving a mystery involving strange red dots spotted in the early universe.

data.title: In Moscow, Russians worry about new fuel shortages
data.description: MOSCOW - The Russian capital braced Wednesday for a possible fresh wave of fuel shortages as drivers queued nervously to fill up tanks after recent Ukrainian strikes.

data.title: Protest denounces secrecy of Venezuela transition talks
data.description: CARACAS - Dozens of protesters rallied Wednesday outside a hotel hosting transition talks in the Venezuelan capital, demanding greater transparency from the authorities and the opposition, AFP journalists observed.

data.title: Eurovision to bar countries at war from hosting
data.description: GENEVA - Eurovision Song Contest organisers announced rule changes Wednesday excluding any country in an armed conflict from hosting the competition and increasing the mininum age of competitors.

data.title: As millions gazed in awe, a swathe of Spain plunged into darkness
data.description: BURGOS (SPAIN) - The total eclipse plunged a vast swathe of Spain from broad daylight into darkness Wednesday, drawing awed gasps and applause from spectators gathered in parks and cities across the country.

data.title: Trump's spokesperson Karoline Leavitt to step down
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt, who earned a reputation for acid putdowns of journalists, is to step down, President Donald Trump announced Wednesday adding she would remain a senior advisor.

data.title: Nigeria kidnap victims escape 'hellfire' captivity beaten, malnourished
data.description: ILORIN (NIGERIA) - Visibly frail and malnourished children and women lay on rows of hospital beds, their bodies bearing the scars of six months of captivity deep in the Nigerian bush.

data.title: 44 lives lost after ferry capsizes on Zimbabwe's Lake Kariba
data.description: HARARE (ZIMBABWE) - At least 44 people drowned after an overcrowded ferry capsized on Zimbabwe's Lake Kariba, police said Wednesday, releasing an updated toll a day after the disaster.

data.title: Colombia declares three days mourning for quake victims
data.description: BOGOTá - Colombia on Wednesday declared three days of mourning for victims of an earthquake that demolished buildings in the west of the country, killing more than 200 people.

data.title: Zhu Rongji, trailblazing ex-premier who transformed China's economy
data.description: BEIJING - Zhu Rongji, China's former premier who died on Wednesday aged 97, championed free-market policies and delivered far-reaching economic reforms during his five years at the helm.

data.title: Former Chinese premier Zhu Rongji dies aged 97
data.description: BEIJING - Former Chinese premier Zhu Rongji, whose market reforms helped drive the country's extraordinary economic rise, died Wednesday at the age of 97.

data.title: WHO says Trump vaccine shake-up goes against evidence
data.description: GENEVA - The World Health Organization warned Wednesday that Donald Trump's bid to overhaul child vaccination in the United States goes against "decades of evidence".
